steps.text: Out of the fridge: Sunday's chipotle beef (take 343 g her+him — the whole 165 g raw batch plus its 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 30 g), Sunday's rice-and-cauliflower, and Sunday's roast peppers and onion.

Beef and its adobo sauce (70/95 g beef, 13/17 g chipotle in adobo) and the peppers and onion (70/90 g + 30/40 g) into a pan on high for 3 minutes, until the edges catch again. The microwave works; the pan is better.
Rice and cauliflower (40/70 g dry cooked + 120/155 g) warmed through alongside.
Build: rice base, beef over one side, black beans (95/105 g) and sweetcorn (25/30 g) the other, salsa (60/70 g) into the middle.
Shredded cabbage (50/60 g) on LAST, off the heat, with the oil (5/6 g) and lime hard over everything. The salsa is doing the job the guacamole used to.

why: Cold things after hot things, never before. Lettuce that has sat under hot beef for two minutes is soup, and it takes the rest of the bowl with it.
notes: D0-003: the finishing oil tossed through the shredded cabbage off the heat stays olive_oil (dressing use, not a hot pan).
D0-003: 'shredded lettuce' in the original step text is explicitly shredded → sweetheart_cabbage.

Seasoning weighing: Sunday's 'chipotle beef' pan uses 2 chopped chipotles in adobo — never gram-tracked in the original card. Standard-reference chipotle_adobo added, whole batch (30 g) consumed entirely by this single-consumer lunch, split 13/17 g proportional to the beef share. Drift +17/+21 kcal — see macro-drift table.

batchTakeG: beef 165 g + adobo 30 g + dry rice 110 g + riced cauliflower 275 g + roast peppers 160 g + roast onion 70 g, all from Sunday's prep; salsa and sweetcorn are fresh additions at plate time, excluded.
